data.content:
**Sent (1):** UE-tf06f, $31.20, computed win probability 90%. The ticket lists only Paneer Tikka Masala and Garlic Naan, so the claimed Butter Chicken isn't on it. The order was ready at 18:47 and picked up at 18:50.

**Drafted but skipped by the owner (3):** I won't retry these.
- **UE-tf07g, $26.80, 65%:** Pickup was 6 minutes after ready. The ticket lists the item, but that doesn't show it was packed. The dispute cites only the pickup record.
- **UE-tf02b, $21.50, 65%:** Pickup was 4 minutes after ready. Same ticket limitation, so the dispute cites only the pickup record.
- **UE-tf03c, $15.00, 77%:** Pickup was 3 minutes after ready. The same account made 3 claims this period (UE-tf03c, UE-tf04d, UE-tf05e). I noted that as a fact and left it out of the dispute.

**Weak:** UE-tf01a, $52.00, 30%. There is no order ticket on file, so I couldn't compare the claimed Chicken Biryani (Family Size) to what was prepared. **I need a photo of the ticket for order UE-tf01a.** If you send one, I'll re-run the evidence check. It is the largest deduction, so it is worth finding.

**Not worked up:**
- **UE-tf04d ($18.25, 45%) and UE-tf05e ($12.75, 55%):** These were outside the top 5, so I didn't gather evidence for them.
- **UE-tf08h ($9.00), UE-tf09i ($14.00, 15%) and UE-tf00z ($0.00, deadline passed):** The triage recommended skipping all three.

No lessons from memory applied. The saved history covers DoorDash only, and the recall for these Uber Eats cases returned no similar past disputes.

**Next deadline:** 2026-12-12, 28 days away. Case notes are in `/plan.md`.
